description: The bar chart compares the distribution of three categories—Context, Generated Response, and Other—between two methods: "Ours" and "Standard." The horizontal axis represents the methods, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage of each category. For the "Ours" method, Context accounts for 60.6%, Generated Response for 7.7%, and Other for a small, unspecified percentage. In contrast, the "Standard" method shows 23.6% for Context, 51.1% for Generated Response, and 25.3% for Other. The bars are color-coded with blue representing Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. The chart does not provide a legend for the "Other" category, but it is represented by a small, light gray bar in both methods. The values are labeled directly on the bars, and the chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
